origine_fr: Un oiseau de profil, avec la tête, l'aile et la queue. On l'a dit des oiseaux à queue courte, face à 鳥, à longue queue, mais les deux s'échangeaient souvent. On l'appelle 锥字边, et on le voit à droite de 谁 et de 难.
origine_en: A bird in profile, with its head, wing and tail. It was said to name short-tailed birds, as opposed to 鳥, the long-tailed ones, but the two were often swapped. It is called 锥字边, and you can spot it on the right of 谁 and 难.
